freshness.warning: Treat unavailable or unknown actor access as unsupported until verified. UI-only capability is not agent-callable by implication.

human_operator.name: Interactive terminal/TUI
human_operator.summary: Hermes provides a CLI/TUI with session resume, interruption, and command shortcuts.

evidence.claim: Hermes provides a CLI/TUI with session resume, interruption, and command shortcuts.

human_operator.name: Desktop or web surface
human_operator.summary: Hermes 0.20 introduced desktop artifacts, a plugin SDK, and multi-window operation.

evidence.claim: Hermes 0.20 introduced desktop artifacts, a plugin SDK, and multi-window operation.

human_operator.name: Agent-native file editing
human_operator.summary: Hermes agents can inspect and edit files through built-in and learned tools.

evidence.claim: Hermes agents can inspect and edit files through built-in and learned tools.

human_operator.name: Agent-native shell execution
human_operator.summary: Hermes can execute shell commands, including direct `!` command shortcuts in recent releases.

evidence.claim: Hermes can execute shell commands, including direct `!` command shortcuts in recent releases.

human_operator.name: Headless/non-interactive execution
human_operator.summary: Hermes can be invoked through CLI/gateway automation, but the seed does not yet verify a stable event protocol equivalent to Codex app-server.

evidence.claim: Hermes can be invoked through CLI/gateway automation, but the seed does not yet verify a stable event protocol equivalent to Codex app-server.

human_operator.name: MCP client
human_operator.summary: Hermes supports MCP servers and Docker-based MCP commands.

evidence.claim: Hermes supports MCP servers and Docker-based MCP commands.

human_operator.name: Agent Skills
human_operator.summary: Hermes discovers skills progressively and can create or improve them through its learning loop and `/learn` workflow.

evidence.claim: Hermes discovers skills progressively and can create or improve them through its learning loop and `/learn` workflow.

human_operator.name: Plugins/extensions
human_operator.summary: Hermes 0.20 added a desktop plugin SDK and extensibility surfaces.

evidence.claim: Hermes 0.20 added a desktop plugin SDK and extensibility surfaces.

human_operator.name: Persistent memory
human_operator.summary: Persistent memory and conversation search are first-class parts of Hermes' self-improving agent model.

evidence.claim: Persistent memory and conversation search are first-class parts of Hermes' self-improving agent model.

human_operator.name: Resume, fork, and session lineage
human_operator.summary: Hermes persists and resumes sessions across CLI and gateway surfaces.

evidence.claim: Hermes persists and resumes sessions across CLI and gateway surfaces.

human_operator.name: Subagents/delegation
human_operator.summary: Hermes can delegate work to specialized agents.

evidence.claim: Hermes can delegate work to specialized agents.

human_operator.name: Parallel/background agents
human_operator.summary: Hermes supports background work and Mixture-of-Agents execution.

evidence.claim: Hermes supports background work and Mixture-of-Agents execution.

human_operator.name: First-class multi-agent coordination
human_operator.summary: Mixture-of-Agents is a first-class coordination mode rather than only ad hoc subagent prompting.

evidence.claim: Mixture-of-Agents is a first-class coordination mode rather than only ad hoc subagent prompting.

human_operator.name: Remote/cloud execution
human_operator.summary: Hermes gateways let users interact through messaging channels while work runs on another machine or cloud VM.

evidence.claim: Hermes gateways let users interact through messaging channels while work runs on another machine or cloud VM.

human_operator.name: Self-hosted worker/runtime
human_operator.summary: Hermes can run on user-owned machines, VPSs, clusters, or serverless infrastructure.

evidence.claim: Hermes can run on user-owned machines, VPSs, clusters, or serverless infrastructure.

human_operator.name: Scheduled tasks
human_operator.summary: Hermes includes scheduled and gateway-driven automation paths.

evidence.claim: Hermes includes scheduled and gateway-driven automation paths.

human_operator.name: Granular permissions and approvals
human_operator.summary: Permission modes such as `/yolo` and gateway/tool configuration govern autonomy; use conservative defaults for unattended runs.
limitations: The security model needs deeper comparative review before enterprise promotion.

evidence.claim: Permission modes such as `/yolo` and gateway/tool configuration govern autonomy; use conservative defaults for unattended runs.

human_operator.name: Web search/research
human_operator.summary: Hermes 0.20 added grounded research and citation support.

evidence.claim: Hermes 0.20 added grounded research and citation support.

human_operator.name: Voice interaction
human_operator.summary: Streaming voice supports barge-in and wake words.

evidence.claim: Streaming voice supports barge-in and wake words.

human_operator.name: Artifacts, diffs, and rich result views
human_operator.summary: Desktop artifacts and multiple windows provide richer outputs than plain terminal text.

evidence.claim: Desktop artifacts and multiple windows provide richer outputs than plain terminal text.

human_operator.name: Model/provider portability
human_operator.summary: Hermes supports multiple hosted and local model providers.

evidence.claim: Hermes supports multiple hosted and local model providers.
